explanation: Pilgrims walk seven times anticlockwise around the Kaaba, the cube-shaped building at the heart of the Great Mosque. Every adult Muslim who is able is expected to make the journey once.

claims.text: The Hajj takes place in and around Mecca, in Saudi Arabia.
The Hajj does not take place in Medina, Jerusalem or Riyadh.
During the Hajj, pilgrims walk seven times anticlockwise around the Kaaba (the tawaf).
The Kaaba is a cube-shaped building at the centre of the Great Mosque of Mecca (Masjid al-Haram).
Every adult Muslim who is physically and financially able is expected to perform the Hajj at least once.
